0022600106.text: The 76ers come in 2-0 after two games, sitting 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East with a two-game winning streak and a 1-0 home record, and this is their third game of the season. The Bucks are 0-1, 4th in the Central and one game back, 13th in the East, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. Philadelphia won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, most recently beating Milwaukee 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026. For the 76ers, Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture) are out, while Dean Wade (ankle, sprain) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain) are day-to-day with game-time decisions.
